description: Check whether an item can be shipped to/from Ukraine with SEMERO (prohibited, needs approval, not shipped by SEMERO, usually allowed), based on SEMERO's published rules. Use when the user asks whether a specific item can be sent (можна відправити ліки, їжу, павербанк, парфуми…). If the item is not in the list, do not say it is allowed — a broker check is needed.
name: restricted_items
